rawContent:
@echo off
title Visible Temp Cleanup (Debug Mode)
color 0E

echo =========================================
echo   TEMP CLEANUP - SHOWING ALL ACTIONS
echo =========================================
echo.

:: Admin check
net session
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    echo.
    echo ERROR: Not running as Administrator!
    echo.
    pause
    exit /b
)

:: -------------------------------
:: Windows Temp
:: -------------------------------
echo.
echo ===== Cleaning C:\Windows\Temp =====
echo.

dir "C:\Windows\Temp"

echo.
echo Deleting files...
del /f /s /q "C:\Windows\Temp\*"

echo.
echo Removing folders...
for /d %%D in ("C:\Windows\Temp\*") do (
    echo Deleting folder: %%D
    rd /s /q "%%D"
)

:: -------------------------------
:: User Temp
:: -------------------------------
echo.
echo ===== Cleaning %TEMP% =====
echo.

dir "%TEMP%"

echo.
echo Deleting files...
del /f /s /q "%TEMP%\*"

echo.
echo Removing folders...
for /d %%D in ("%TEMP%\*") do (
    echo Deleting folder: %%D
    rd /s /q "%%D"
)

:: -------------------------------
:: Prefetch
:: -------------------------------
echo.
echo ===== Cleaning Prefetch =====
echo.

dir "%SystemRoot%\Prefetch"

echo.
echo Deleting files...
del /f /q "%SystemRoot%\Prefetch\*"

echo.
echo =========================================
echo   CLEANUP FINISHED - REVIEW ABOVE OUTPUT
echo =========================================
pause
